Who pays when climate disasters strike?
52 minutes ago|
Duration

Nepal has become the first country to have funding provisionally set aside from the UN's Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage following devastating flooding. But Nepal needs billions to rebuild, and the fund has set aside just millions. From the Himalayas to the COP31 climate summit, can the international community deliver the help vulnerable countries need?
